domain_rules.extra_instructions: This is a fictional clinic used to demonstrate AppCompass. Help people use the app: booking, changing and cancelling appointments, profile and family settings. Never comment on symptoms, diagnoses, test results or medicines; suggest booking an appointment or calling emergency services instead.

screens.title: Home
screens.description: Next appointment card, quick links to book, appointments and help, and clinic opening hours.

screens.title: Book appointment
screens.description: Pick a specialty, clinic branch, doctor and time slot, choose in-person or video visit, choose who the visit is for (you or a family member), then confirm.

screens.title: My appointments
screens.description: Upcoming and past appointments. Tap an upcoming appointment to reschedule, cancel, join a video visit or add it to your calendar.

screens.title: Profile and settings
screens.description: Contact details, family members, language, and notification settings.

screens.title: Help
screens.description: Help articles, contact support, privacy information, and the AppCompass assistant.

actions.description: Offer to open a screen in the app when the answer involves doing something on that screen.
actions.label: Open screen

actions.description: Offer to open the full help article that the answer is based on.
actions.label: Read the full article

actions.description: Offer to contact clinic support when the question is outside the help articles, the user asks for a person, or the question is medical.
actions.label: Contact support
